g.text: Independent Host, shared Seating capability, ComboMeal and Happy Hour
-seatUsing(role: Seating, customer: Customer, table: Table) : void
+takeOrder(customer: Customer, item: MenuItemInterface, bill: int) : void
beginService() applies recovery before staff choices.
Happy Hour: activate once at turn start;
active on that turn and the next.
Lock the resulting cents in the new Order.
Existing orders keep their agreed prices.
Reference fields are represented by association ends, not duplicated in compartments.
The waiting list is an ordered subset of customers; it is not a second composition owner.
Proposed catalogue: three dishes + three distinct unordered combos. Host and Waiter retain separate one-task allowances.
PROPOSED DESIGN - not an assertion of implemented code | SC2002 Ch. 6 notation; Ch. 9 responsibility boundaries.
